J9 and J8 'Wireless module' headers (each drawn as 2 columns x 7 SMD pads) are not transcribed: a separate 2x7 legend (IO1 IO2 / IO10 IO16 / IO9 IO15 / IO3 NC / 3V3 IO46 / GND IO0 / 5V NC) sits between them, but the image does not show which pads each legend entry belongs to or whether each J is 1x7 or 2x7.
notes: PCB silkscreen render of the CrowPanel ESP32 Display 2.8 inch (Advance_series), SKU DIS01728A, V1.0. Compound names (IO15_SDA, IO43-TX0) recorded as printed.
